EXPERIMENT.TITLE: GSM7022369: Whole-body reprogramming, cohort 2, lane 2 (multiplexed scRNA-seq); Mus musculus; RNA-Seq

LIBRARY_DESCRIPTOR.LIBRARY_CONSTRUCTION_PROTOCOL: Live cells were isolated from the SVZ for single-cell RNA-seq. Briefly, mice were terminally anesthetized with avertin (0.5 mg/g mouse, Sigma-Aldrich T48402-25G) in PBS (Corning 21-040-CV), then perfused transcardially with 15 ml of PBS + heparin (50 U/ml, Sigma-Aldrich H3149-50KU) to remove circulating blood cells. Brains were removed into PIPES buffer on ice and dissected in ice-cold PIPES buffer. The lateral wall of the SVZs from both hemispheres were carefully dissected under a dissecting microscope using forceps, scalpel with no.22 blade, and 22.5 degree stab knife. SVZs were minced, then digested in papain solution (14 U/ml, Worthington LS003119) for 10 min at 37oC. After centrifugation at 300g for 5 min at 4oC, liquid was removed and ovomucoid solution (0.7 mg/ml ovomucoid (Sigma-Aldrich T9253-1G), 0.5 mg/ml DNaseI (Sigma-Aldrich DN25-100MG), in DMEM/F12 (Gibco 11330057) was added. Tissue was triturated with a P1000 pipette to obtain single cell suspension. Cells were then layered onto 22% v/v Percoll (Sigma-Aldrich GE17-0891-01) in PBS and centrifuged at 700g for 10 min at 4oC without brakes to remove myelin debris. Supernatant, containing myelin and debris, was removed. Cell pellet was then resuspended in FACS buffer (1% BSA (Sigma A7979) + 0.1% glucose (Sigma G7021) in PBS) to wash and filtered through 40 um strainer. Cells were centrifuged at 300g for 5 min at 4oC, then resuspended in 70 ul of FACS buffer with DAPI (1 mg/ml, Thermo 62248). Live cells were isolated by FACS on a BD Aria sorter using a 100 um nozzle at 20 psi and collected in 750 ul FACS buffer in a protein low-bind microfuge tube (Eppendorf 0030108442). To allow multiplexing of multiple mice into a single 10x lane, cells were labeled with lipid-modified oligonucleotides at 4oC using a protocol (Buckley et al. 2022) adapted from MULTI-seq (McGinnis et al. 2019). The entirety of each sample was labeled and used. Cells from 2-6 mice were combined after labeling and loaded onto each lane of a 10x Genomics chip. 10x Genomics Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3' kits (v3.0 for whole-body reprogramming 1; v3.1 for all others) were used for library construction according to manufacturer's protocol.
